visualCharacteristics.structure: round photo + name + roles + social links
visualCharacteristics.purpose: default: centred person card (round photo, name, roles, dark social-icon bar) for the About Us team; byline: horizontal author row (photo, name + role left, social icons right) above a divider on articles

contentPattern.structure: one row per person: photo cell | details cell (name heading, roles paragraph, social links)
contentPattern.byline: single row laid out horizontally with a divider above

reuseGuidance: Use for a person: team member card (default) or article author byline (byline). Social links are detected by domain (facebook, twitter/x, instagram, linkedin, youtube, ...) or by being in a list.
